triage.reason: The host-synchronized mobile operator queue is a bounded mechanism, but today it is supported only by one official product announcement and does not pass the evidence-sufficiency gate for selection.

Billing-principal model admission is a strong bounded authority question, but the same-day pool contains only GitHub's announcement and no independent comparison, implementation, benchmark or incident evidence.

Compaction-checkpoint authorization provenance is concrete and high-value implementation evidence, but it remains one implementation and is less evidence-complete than the selected cross-sample tool-interruption comparison.

Together with independent Google ADK evidence in SIG-20260904-005, this exposes the same bounded failure class across authentication and human-confirmation interruptions: recovery evidence must survive while autonomous tool replay remains suppressed.
This is retained as the independent cross-sample evidence for selected object Q-20260904-03 rather than selected again as a second semantically overlapping object.

The reproducible cross-benchmark artifact is strong research evidence and remains a serious candidate, but today's Open-source slot gives priority to the higher-scoring direct agent-governance failure around interrupted tool-call replay.

reading.workResult: Skill 03 completed source-bounded Deep Reading for the only selected same-date object Q-20260904-03 after the owning Queue stage repaired its source identity. OpenAI Codex commit 0650d6d1ca451b67009b3969a82b87e76979975f preserves one or more WWW-Authenticate challenges after silent OAuth recovery fails and converts the interruption into a failed MCP tool-call result carrying mcp/www_authenticate metadata rather than automatically replaying the rejected call; its integration coverage observes the agent event stream and constrains the rejected MCP tools/call to one occurrence. Google ADK commit cb0eb2288bfe6536bd6e98f0601d3736844062ca fixes an independent confirmation-pause recurrence path by setting tool_context.actions.skip_summarization=True when an MCP call requests confirmation, preventing the pause result from returning to the model loop and re-invoking the tool; targeted tests cover both constant and callable confirmation policies. Reading distinguishes bounded silent recovery, human-confirmation resume, model reinvocation and a genuinely new tool invocation, and preserves the negative boundary that neither implementation proves exactly-once external effects, distributed deduplication or that a remote side effect could not have committed before an observed failure. No Research Analysis, article writing, visualization, Production or Publication was performed in Reading.

analysis.workResult: Applied Skill 04 only to the single completed same-date Reading Note. Q-20260904-03 formed the bounded judgment that recovery evidence must not become replay authority: an interrupted tool call should preserve Recovery Evidence, Resume/Execution Authority and External-effect Evidence as separate state dimensions. OpenAI Codex and Google ADK independently suppress autonomous replay at different interruption boundaries—failed post-refresh authentication and human-confirmation pause—supporting an evidence-bearing interruption state rather than an ordinary result/error transition that immediately re-enters execution. The analysis preserves the negative boundary that neither maintainer change establishes exactly-once external effects, distributed deduplication, approver identity, or proof that a remote side effect did not commit before an observed failure. One Research Object was durably prepared with valid YAML frontmatter, date=2026-09-04, status=ReadyForProduction, production_input_authorized=true and exact queue_item Q-20260904-03. No article writing, cover generation, Production staging or Publication was performed.
